title: Sourcing Plan: Northwind Robotics - Senior Backend Engineer
subtitle: Talent Team · Intake, Tue 4 Aug, 45 min
intro: A worked example of the content JSON the docx builder expects. Every block type appears at least once, so this doubles as a format reference. Run: node ../scripts/build_prep_pack.js example-content.json example.docx

blocks.text: Hiring manager (VP Engineering) plus the current tech lead
The title says Senior Backend Engineer. The JD describes platform work: multi-tenant data isolation, queue throughput, and on-call ownership.

blocks.label: The #1 flag —
blocks.text: "Full-stack comfortable" appears once in the JD and nowhere in the responsibilities. Test whether frontend is a genuine requirement or an aspiration.

runs.t: rather than a generalist product engineer. Confirm live.

blocks.text: Is high-throughput distributed systems a hard requirement or a tiebreaker?
Platform engineer or product engineer — which rejection would they defend?
Hybrid in one hub, or open across the country?
Describe the last person who did this well here. What made them effective?
blocks.listen: Whether they describe scope and ownership, or a technology list.

blocks.text: Which of these requirements would you drop to get someone two weeks sooner?
blocks.listen: The real hard gates. Everything they hesitate over is a preference.

blocks.text: Replace with 6 to 8 real, verified profiles. Each block: link first, then rationale, tier hypothesis, and the question it tests.
Profile link, then one line on why, then the question this profile tests on the call.
Near-miss on paper, wrong on one describable axis. Forces the hiring manager to name the axis out loud.
